name: The Kiyo Bank, Ltd.
summary: The Kiyo Bank, Ltd. engages in the provision of various banking products and services to individual and corporate customers in Japan. It offers deposits, loans, securities investment, domestic foreign exchange, foreign exchange, buying and selling of government bonds, agency services, etc. It also provides investment advisory services. The company was formerly known as Kiyo Bank Co., Ltd. and changed its name to The Kiyo Bank, Ltd. in October 2013. The Kiyo Bank, Ltd. was incorporated in 1895 and is headquartered in Wakayama, Japan.
